description:
A special all-day broadcast, celebrating the music and legacy of Alice Coltrane – jazz innovator, spiritual leader, and mother.
Featuring guest artist contributions, interviews, appearances from Coltrane's family, as well as deep music mixes for anyone needing a reminder of Coltrane's otherworldly talents.
Presented in collaboration with The Hammer Museum in LA, and the opening of their Coltrane exhibition "Alice Coltrane, Monument Eternal" this weekend – curating "work from contemporary American artists, paired with ephemera from Coltrane’s personal archive".
title: Monument Eternal: An Alice Coltrane Special
